flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToBack.prose: Flip if 4 ISB agents are on table OR ISB agents control at least 2 Rebel Base locations (control-with).

children.req: controls-with >=2 locations (you control location, with your ISB agent there)

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if no ISB agents are on table (cannot spot even one).

requirementSemantics: Front alternative A = COUNT-ON-TABLE (canSpot with count 4), not control or occupy. Undercover ISB agents still spottable; excluded-from-battle included.
Front alternative B = CONTROL-WITH: you control 2 Rebel Base locations each having an ISB agent there.
Back flip = ABSENCE: zero spottable ISB agents anywhere (loss of all agents flips you back).

ISB agent status is objective-granted: both sides add Keyword.ISB_AGENT + Keyword.SPY to your characters with 'ISB'/'Rebel'/'Rebels'/'Rebellion' in lore (KeywordModifier); Filters.ISB_agent keys off that keyword. Card7_299.java:58-66, Card7_299_BACK.java:69-74
typedIdentities: Filters.Rebel_Base_location - front flip gate locations (alternative B)

Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.character, Filters.or(Filters.loreContains("ISB"), Filters.loreContains("Rebel"), Filters.loreContains("Rebels"), Filters.loreContains("Rebellion"))) - who becomes an ISB agent/spy
Filters.not(Filters.undercover_spy) - back drain bonus requires non-Undercover agent
Filters.battleground_site + Filters.sameOrRelatedLocationAs - back drain modifier scopes
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (front, required): deploy any Coruscant location from Reserve Deck (Filters.Coruscant_location). Card7_299.java:45-55
Back, once during each of your draw phases: retrieve one ISB agent (RetrieveCardEffect, Filters.ISB_agent). Card7_299_BACK.java:47-62

No download/tutor of characters on the front; agents must be deployed normally (they ignore location deployment restrictions in their game text via IgnoresLocationDeploymentRestrictionsInGameTextModifier, both sides).
otherObligations: Both sides: your lore-matching characters are ISB agents and spies and may deploy regardless of location deployment restrictions in their game text. Card7_299.java:58-66, Card7_299_BACK.java:65-78
Back: your Force drains +1 at battleground sites where you have a non-Undercover ISB agent. Card7_299_BACK.java:68,75
Back: opponent's Force drains -1 at same and related locations of those sites. Card7_299_BACK.java:76
Strategic: keep at least one ISB agent on table at all times or the objective flips back to front.
